demonstration_policy: prior uses the saved first format-pilot prefix; fresh sets independently generated at depths0,1,3 with the same target labels A,D,G and order
query_overlap_policy: reject query prompts seen in original manifest, previous format pilot, any chosen demonstration or this new query set; try cyclic counterfactual label offsets1..7 and deterministic shuffled-object backtracking without model feedback
pre_execution_design_note: CPU validation found too few unused no-swap prompts in the original six-object vocabulary, even with cyclic pairings. Two ordinary query objects cup/pen were declared before inference; identical queries and object choices are used across all four contexts. No model outcome informed this feasibility correction.
limitations: Only zero/one-swap development examples; not a multi-step reasoning or held-out competence test.
Sixteen semantic pairs are reused across four contexts and two sides; responses are not independent.
Removing demonstrations changes both content and prompt length; the two same-format fresh sets help assess context specificity but do not isolate every factor.
Few-shot target labels and depth ordering remain fixed; this is not a search for the best demonstration set.
The query vocabulary includes two objects absent from the demonstration vocabulary to satisfy freshness; this is an additional generalization factor held fixed across contexts.
The unchanged predeclared parser accepts a leading label optionally preceded by box; no responses are manually rescued.
Old score definitions and old failing examples are not replaced by this new diagnostic.
